notExposed: ANNOTATION_LITERAL code is the decoded text without quotes (`/x`), unlike C# LITERAL (`"/a"`) and Kotlin ANNOTATION_LITERAL (`"fa"`)

shapes.example: METHOD m -> ANNOTATION GetMapping -> ANNOTATION_PARAMETER_ASSIGN -> [ANNOTATION_PARAMETER value, ANNOTATION_LITERAL '/x']
shapes.joern: ANNOTATION name `GetMapping`, fullName `ANY`, parent METHOD; child ANNOTATION_PARAMETER_ASSIGN (code `"/x"`) with children ANNOTATION_PARAMETER `value` and ANNOTATION_LITERAL whose code is `/x` (no quotes).
Marker annotation: ANNOTATION node, no children; fullName is the resolved `java.lang.Override` / `java.lang.Deprecated`.

Two ANNOTATION_PARAMETER_ASSIGN children; `value = "/a"` has an ANNOTATION_LITERAL `/a`, `method = RequestMethod.GET` has only the ANNOTATION_PARAMETER `method` (the non-literal value is not a literal node).
ANNOTATION_PARAMETER_ASSIGN whose value child is an ARRAY_INITIALIZER (code `{ "a", "b" }`); its children are ANNOTATION_LITERALs with code `a` and `b` (no quotes).

unobserved: annotations on classes, fields or parameters
